title: PARDUS Robin EVO owner review photos
notes: An owner's review of a PARDUS Robin EVO, with photos of the same bike. The photos show a SRAM RED AXS crank, a SRAM AXS rear derailleur and Zipp 454 rims, so they do not show the Force AXS and Zipp 303 S build listed for this record. One reviewed photo is used only to identify the Robin EVO frame platform. The post shows its date without a year and does not name the frame generation; its ride and noise opinions are not recorded here.
